name: pi-ext
description: Goal, Codex compaction, Fast Mode, UI, subagent, MCP, and permissions extensions for Pi Coding Agent
license: (MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND MPL-2.0 AND Unicode-3.0)
author: Wang Xuyang

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p ./extensions/codex-compact/tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/codex-compact-media.mjs copy && tsc -p ./extensions/openai-fast-mode/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/codex-ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/permissions/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/subagent/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/goal/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/skill-mentions/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p ./extensions/codex-compact/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/openai-fast-mode/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm run build:codex-ui && tsc -p ./extensions/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/permissions/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/subagent/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/goal/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/skill-mentions/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm run repository:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run web-search:typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm run package:check && pnpm run host:check
scripts.codex-compact:quality:check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 conda run -n codex-py312 python -m unittest discover -s extensions/codex-compact/__tests__ -p 'quality_*_test.py'
scripts.web-search:check: pnpm run web-search:typecheck && pnpm test extensions/codex-search/__tests__ && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-search/__tests__/fixtures/search-ui/smoke.py --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-search/__tests__/fixtures/search-ui/smoke.py --fullscreen --restart && pnpm run web-search:resume:check
scripts.web-search:resume:check: conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-search/__tests__/resume-tui.py && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-search/__tests__/resume-tui.py --fullscreen && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-search/__tests__/resume-tui.py --disabled
scripts.codemode:check: pnpm run build:codex-ui && pnpm test extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/codemode*.test.ts && node extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/codemode-cli.mjs --smoke && node extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/codemode-benchmark.mjs && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/codemode-pty.py && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/codemode-pty.py --fullscreen
scripts.goal:footer:check: conda run -n codex-py312 python ./extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-tui-driver.py && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-tui-driver.py --fullscreen && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-tui-driver.py --native && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-tui-driver.py --native --fullscreen
scripts.tool-status:check: pnpm run build && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/tool-status/smoke.py --play --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/tool-status/smoke.py --play --fullscreen --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/tool-status/smoke.py --lowpower --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/tool-status/smoke.py --lowpower --fullscreen --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/tool-status/smoke.py --mcp-only --restart
